requirements_summary: Short bullets: p95 latency target 100-120ms for chat; 200+ rps sustained; budget-conscious - prefer configs that hit <50% of current inference cost; routing/fallback to cheaper quantized model under load; KV/prefix caching for market-context prompts; VPC + KMS + audit logs required; ability to pin model versions during rollouts.
perf_targets: p95 <= 120ms, median <= 45ms, steady throughput 120 rps, burst capacity up to 250 rps (99th percentile handled), cost per million tokens target < $X (TBD during bench)
batching_caching_prefs: Prefer micro-batching with max wait 10-15ms; aggressive KV prefix caching for repeated market-context prefixes; per-route batching profiles; disable large batching for trader-facing flows (latency first) and enable larger batching for non-interactive reranking jobs.
quantization_prefs: Open to 8-bit and 4-bit QAT/PTQ variants; want quality baseline tests for 4-bit vs 8-bit on their internal eval set; accept slight BLEU/semantic drift if latency/cost improvements clear; want Redwood Optimize suggested quantization profiles plus rollback policy.
benchmarking_requests: Run A: Hosted API baseline using 13B open model (no quant) - capture p50/p95/p99, per-token cost
Run B: Dedicated pilot - 8-bit quant config - steady-state 120 rps + bursts to 250 rps - measure tail latency and GPU utilization
Run C: Dedicated pilot - 4-bit quant config - same workload; measure quality regression on internal eval set and cost savings
Run D: Caching enabled - KV/prefix caching for repeated prefixes to show per-request token savings
Run E: Batching policy sweep - vary max-latency threshold 5/10/15/25ms and observe end-to-end user latency impact
